# i-Tech Support, Inc. (I-Tech Support, Inc)

i-Tech Support, Inc. is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. i-Tech Support provides managed IT and Acumatica ERP services in Florida, offering plans and pricing, cybersecurity and compliance, cloud and infrastructure, help desk, backup and disaster recovery, and virtual cio/cto services. I-Tech Support, Inc. employs 98 people (+10.1% YoY, +9 people) and has an annual revenue of $6.5M, founded in 1999. Headquartered in Ocoee, Florida, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, and Qatar).

## About

Since 1999, i-Tech Support has helped businesses, non-profits and schools achieve their goals by supporting them with technology that simply works.
